description: Land Title Settlement Department - Muwagama, Ratnapura D/S/Division Ratnapura District - Cad. Map No.620272 (24/0320)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration and determinations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules of specific land parcels, their ownership status (private or state), extent, and other land-related particulars. The content focuses entirely on land and property matters, falling squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
